fact.thing: yearly fee difference on $7,000 held in a 0% all-in-one ETF instead of XEQT
fact.claim: Scotia launched four all-in-one ETFs on October 26, 2026 (SBCN, SBBA, SBGR, SBEQ), and the manager is waiving fees so each one's MER is expected to be 0.00% until October 31, 2027. XEQT, the all-in-one most Canadians hold, has a 0.20% MER as of its June 19, 2026 ETF Facts. On one year of filled TFSA room, which is $7,000 for 2026, that gap is about $14 a year: roughly $14 of fees in XEQT versus about $0 in the Scotia funds while the waiver lasts. The waiver is temporary, and the standard 0.15% management fee plus other expenses starts November 1, 2027, so the saving only runs for the waiver period and the funds are new with short track records.
